points.description: States that the jump from 0 to 1.5 V means there is a gap (break/open circuit/separation) between the two terminals where the leads were placed, i.e. the voltage is dropped across that gap. Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark for saying the terminals are separated by a gap (break/open in the circuit). No mark for answers that don't mention a gap or break, e.g. just saying the battery is 1.5 V.
